services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: Making an Impression: Pioneering Latin American Printmakers presents a multigenerational group of four artists who have redefined printmaking through material and perceptual innovation. Featuring works by Rufino Tamayo, Jesús Rafael Soto, Regina Silveira, and Analia Saban, the exhibition highlights printmaking as a dynamic and continually evolving field of artistic experimentation. Together, works by these artists reimagine the boundaries of the medium beyond the flat page-exploring texture, spatial illusion, and the printed matrix itself. Rufino Tamayo, Hombre en la Ventana, 1980, Mixografía print on handmade paper, Edition of 100, 35 x 27 inches. Collection of Museo Internacional de Arte

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The museum's dramatic Grand Lobby showcases granite floors beneath a magnificent 23-foot Sol LeWitt masterpiece, while floor-to-ceiling glass walls create a captivating dialogue between Charlotte's urban sophistication and your private celebration. The adjacent Plaza Terrace, sheltered beneath a striking cantilevered gallery, features the whimsical Firebird sculpture as a conversation piece for al fresco entertaining. This premier combination offers the ultimate in versatility-seamlessly transitioning between intimate indoor refinement and open-air elegance, accommodating your guests' every preference with uncompromising style.
